## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 202 image captures during November 2022. Activity proceeded as expected, with sessions conducted across the reporting period. The site recorded attendance and capture activity for review through the routine service process. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issues were identified in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading in nearly all cases. Of the 202 captures, 2 photographs were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.0 per cent. The ungradable images were excluded from grading outcomes. The result indicates that the large majority of images obtained at Central Eye Clinic could be assessed through the usual grading process.

## Grading

Grading identified 48 referable results from the activity recorded in November 2022. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 2 days. This provides the reported measure of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. The activity, image quality and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing the site’s performance for the month.
